s: Who criticized the subject centered traditional curriculum?
x:
Printed key: Alfred North Whitehead. Many pedagogy books instead link John Dewey with the criticism of the subject-centred traditional curriculum (child-centred / activity curriculum).
A.N. Whitehead ('The Aims of Education') attacked 'inert ideas' and the fatal disconnection of subjects in the traditional curriculum; the printed key is Whitehead.

s: According to Freud, during which period super ego is developed?
x:
Printed key / many guides: Latency period. Strictly: Freud has the superego form at the end of the phallic stage, when the Oedipus complex is resolved (Britannica).
Printed key: latency period, as many teacher-education guides state that the superego develops/consolidates in latency. Freud himself placed the formation of the superego at the resolution of the Oedipus complex at the end of the phallic stage (about age 5-6). Off-topic here; moved to psychology.
